backfold: A replacement panel slots into a folded history while the surrounding readings stay in place.
streamsieve: Several telemetry channels pass through a sieve, and a marked strip carries the changed channel’s samples.
chronosieve: A change rings a bell, representing the compact digest that can wake a monitoring agent.
causalsieve: A marked upstream domino leads two later changes, illustrating how CausalSieve ranks incident candidates.
flashmp: Two impressions show the same subsequence shape at different levels and amplitudes.
tsjit: One incoming reading feeds a fan of nine forecast quantiles.
recastcrps: One forecast bead moves while the other ensemble members and the observed outcome stay fixed.
